name: labs/machineagency__science-jubilee
title: Science Jubilee motion platform (science_jubilee.Machine.Machine)
intro: Science Jubilee motion platform (science_jubilee.Machine.Machine), adapted from machineagency/science-jubilee. It reads `x_position`, `y_position` and `z_position`; runs `move_to`, `home` and `set_tool_offset`. `move_to`: move the tool centre point to a Cartesian position and orientation in a named frame. The endpoint solves inverse kinematics; an unreachable target is rejected before motion. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
